How Does Google Decide Which Ad to Show You?

Hook: You Search. Ads Appear. But Who Picks Them? 

SCENE 1 — 4–9 sec
 VO:
“Behind every Google ad you see is a quick process called an ad auction.”
SCENE 2 — 9–17 sec
 VO:
“When you search, Google looks at the advertisers competing for that search and checks factors like bid, ad relevance, and quality.”
SCENE 3 — 17–25 sec
 VO:
“But the highest bidder doesn't automatically win. Google also considers how useful and relevant the ad is to your search.”
SCENE 4 — 25–31 sec
 VO:
“The result? Google ranks the eligible ads and decides which ones to show you.”
CTA — 31–37 sec
 VO:
“Want to understand how digital advertising works? Follow OneClick Academy for more.”

Ever wondered why one Google ad appears instead of another? 👀
When you search, Google runs a quick ad auction to determine which eligible ads are shown. It considers factors like bid, ad relevance, and quality — so the highest bidder doesn't automatically win.
Understanding how the ad auction works can help marketers create more relevant ads and smarter campaigns. 🎯
